scope: 公开默认分支的专用源码/导入/接口签名；每查询前100条，stars≥1000且默认分支7天内活跃。含官方仓库、fork、示例和文档，不代表生产用户或全网采用量。
verification: Returned Git blob SHA verified; provider-specific literal and attribution checks applied to every counted file.

candidate_refresh.rule: Union previously discovered provider-specific files; refresh metadata and verify current HEAD blobs.
